func _execute_move_command(command: PlayerCommand) -> void:
	if companion_roster_open:
		return
	var coord := command.target_hex()
	if coord not in reachable_hexes or coord == PartyManager.get_exploration_position():
		return

	var path := hex_grid.find_path(PartyManager.get_exploration_position(), coord)
	if path.is_empty():
		return

	# Perform movement step-by-step or instantly
	var cost: float = reachable_hexes[coord]
	remaining_speed -= cost
	has_moved_this_turn = true

	# Update player position
	PartyManager.move_exploration_party(coord)
	_update_grid_entities()
	var visited_tile := hex_grid.get_tile(coord)
	GameManager.record_overworld_location(coord, visited_tile.location_name if visited_tile != null else "")

	# Recalculate Vision
	FogOfWar.update_visibility(hex_grid)

	hud.add_log("%s moved to hex %s (Spent %.1f movement points)" % [
		PlayerManager.get_active_player()["character"].character_name,
		coord,
		cost
	])

	# Update HUD
	hud.update_hud()

	# Resolve destination tile
	_resolve_destination_tile(coord)

func popup_event(character: Character, event_data: Dictionary) -> void:
	_popup_generation += 1
	_cancel_ability_bonus_prompt()
	SpellDamageRolls.cancel_ability_check_requests_for_host(self)
	active_character = character
	event = event_data.duplicate(true)
	var incoming_event_id := str(event.get("id", ""))
	var loaded_event: Dictionary = DataLoader.get_event_record(incoming_event_id)
	if not loaded_event.is_empty():
		event = loaded_event.get("event", {}).duplicate(true)
	last_skill_check_result.clear()
	_pending_authored_context.clear()
	
	title_label.text = event.get("name", "An Event Occurs")
	desc_label.text = event.get("description", "")
	
	# Clear choices and reset UI state from potential previous events in a chain
	for child in choice_container.get_children():
		child.queue_free()

	choice_container.visible = true
	roll_section.visible = false
	btn_close.visible = false
	btn_close.text = "Close"
	btn_roll.disabled = false
	roll_result_lbl.text = ""

	# Handle event types
	var event_type: String = event.get("type", "normal")
	
	match event_type:
		"choice":
			_build_choice_buttons()
		"skill_check":
			_setup_skill_check_section(event, str(event.get("id", "")))
		"loot":
			_resolve_loot_event()
		"chain":
			_resolve_chain_event()
		"combat":
			_resolve_direct_combat_event()
		_: # normal / event check fallback
			_resolve_simple_event()

func _apply_milestone_effect(effect: Dictionary) -> void:
	var effect_type: String = effect.get("type", "")
	match effect_type:
		"level_up":
			# Level up every active party member, including recruited companions.
			for character in PartyManager.get_active_characters():
				character.level_up()
				print("[GameManager] %s leveled up!" % character.character_name)
		_:
			push_warning("[GameManager] Unknown milestone effect type: %s" % effect_type)
